---
title: "FASTQ Metadata"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
path <- "data/derived/fastq.csv"
if (file.exists(path)) {
  df <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df %>% select(giab_id, file_url, filesize_gb, tech, total_sequences, total_bases, pct_gc, mode_length) %>%
    head(50) %>% knitr::kable()
} else {
  cat("Derived FASTQ table not found. Run scripts/01_ingest.R, 02_transform.R first.")
}
```
